subject: Spin-out billing: treasury handoff & VAT treatment
messages:
From: Anna Keller <anna.keller@silverpine.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Yun Choe <yun.choe@taxadvisersapac.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Spin-out billing: treasury handoff & VAT treatment

Hi Evelyn,

Quick heads-up — Silverpine is completing a carve-out of our cloud division to a new legal entity, Silverpine Cloud Pty Ltd (Australia), effective 2026-09-01. Finance needs to update billing and payment routing with Redwood before the cutover. Key asks:

- Can Redwood start issuing invoices dated >= 2026-09-01 to the new legal name and ABN?
- We will provide formal ABN and bank remittance. Please confirm whether Redwood can reissue any August invoices that land after the cutover to the new entity (or if we should expect credits + reissue).
- VAT/GST: our APAC tax advisor (cc'd) would like to confirm invoice header fields required for GST purposes and whether Redwood can include ABN on invoice PDF metadata.

I've attached a short summary of the corporate split for reference (Silverpine_Spinout_Summary.pdf). Can you propose a simple cutover playbook and timeline? We aim to have billing and PO routing verified by 2026-08-26 to give treasury time for bank cutover.

Thanks — let me know the best way to coordinate (call or single-threaded email).

Anna Keller
CFO, Silverpine Holdings
anna.keller@silverpine.com
+61 2 5555 0101
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Keller <anna.keller@silverpine.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spin-out billing: treasury handoff & VAT treatment

Anna — thanks for the context and the summary. We can support the change but need a few specific items to avoid billing gaps. Proposed immediate next steps: 

1) Please send the exact new legal name, ABN and the full new billing address (street + postal).
2) Confirm whether you want invoices before 2026-09-01 to remain with Silverpine Holdings or be reissued to Silverpine Cloud (we can do credits + reissue, but that requires treasury approval).
3) Provide the accounts-payable contact and a preferred PO number format.

Operational notes: 
- Redwood can include ABN on the invoice PDF header and metadata. We will also add a distinct remit-to field so bank reconciliation is straightforward.
- If you need reissued invoices for August, we require signed authorization from your AP/treasury lead and bank remittance evidence to support refund/credit flow.

I've looped in Marissa (AE) for timeline and Aditya (Finance Ops) for credits and reissue policy. We can do a short call tomorrow at 09:00 PT if that helps.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Finance (Americas)
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Keller <anna.keller@silverpine.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Spin-out billing: proposed cutover checklist and dates

Anna / team — putting a short cutover playbook here so everyone has the same checklist. Attachment: Spinout_InvoiceCutover_Checklist.xlsx (summary below).

Cutover playbook (recommended):
- 2026-08-20: Confirm legal name + ABN + billing address + AP contact (Anna).
- 2026-08-22: Redwood sets up new billing entity in our system; test invoice generated and sent to your AP test mailbox.
- 2026-09-01: Invoices dated on/after 2026-09-01 issued to Silverpine Cloud Pty Ltd.
- 2026-09-03 to 2026-09-10: If AP requests, Redwood will credit and reissue any invoices that were created to the old entity during the cutover window (requires AP authorization + bank statement evidence).

Please review and confirm the dates; Marissa will own the cutover schedule and single-thread communications. If you need earlier invoice reissues, call out which invoice numbers and we will prioritize.

Thanks — Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Anna Keller <anna.keller@silverpine.com>

Subject: Re: Spin-out billing: proposed cutover checklist and dates

Thanks Marissa — confirmed, dates work. A couple of clarifications: 

- Attached is the ABN certificate and the formal remittance instructions (Silverpine_ABN_certificate.pdf).
- For any invoice reissue/credit: treasury requests a one-off courtesy credit if duplicate charges result from the same billing period during the cutover. We understand this needs approval — please advise the approval path.

FYI: Our treasury contact is Michael Tang (michael.tang@silverpine.com). Please send the test invoice to ap@silverpinecloud.com.

2) We'll generate the test invoice to ap@silverpinecloud.com on 2026-08-22 as planned. If the test invoice looks good, we will schedule full cutover for 2026-09-01.
